_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Reclaiming the House#000.src: Join Elphaba on a mission in the Temporary Camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Reclaiming the House#000.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的临时营地加入 Elphaba 的任务

Reclaiming the House#001.src: Oh, a Wynnic soldier out here in the boondocks? Honestly, you're just what we need- I could use your help, if you're able?
Reclaiming the House#001.dst: 噢，这种穷乡僻壤竟然有 Wynn 的士兵？说真的，你正是我们需要的人——如果可以的话，能帮我个忙吗？
Reclaiming the House#001.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#002.src: Good, thank you. Let me lock down the camp before I give you the briefing, though.
Reclaiming the House#002.dst: 很好，谢谢。不过先让我把营地封锁好，再给你做简报。
Reclaiming the House#002.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#003.src: My name is Elphaba. I've been working with the Gavellian army for a good few years now.
Reclaiming the House#003.dst: 我叫 Elphaba。我在 Gavel 军队服役好几年了。
Reclaiming the House#003.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#004.src: I'm the commander of the {p} Outpost down ahead. It's a strategic fortress, placed to monitor the Orcish capital.
Reclaiming the House#004.dst: 我是前面 {p} 前哨站的指挥官。那是一座战略要塞，用来监视兽人的首都。
Reclaiming the House#004.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#005.src: It was safe for a long while, but especially in the past while the Orcs have gotten far bolder, more aggressive.
Reclaiming the House#005.dst: 那里安全了很长一段时间，但尤其是最近，兽人变得大胆得多，也更有攻击性。
Reclaiming the House#005.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#006.src: They overwhelmed the outpost- we had to retreat and set up this camp to watch over the place we used to watch over them with!
Reclaiming the House#006.dst: 他们攻陷了前哨站——我们只好撤退，建起这个营地，来监视我们原本用来监视他们的地方！
Reclaiming the House#006.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#007.src: I need more firepower if I'm going... to get...
Reclaiming the House#007.dst: 如果我要……夺回……我需要更多火力……
Reclaiming the House#007.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#008.src: ...oh no. See, this is what I mean! The orcs are coming!
Reclaiming the House#008.dst: ……噢不。你看，我说的就是这个！兽人来了！
Reclaiming the House#008.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#009.src: Brace yourself, soldier! Protect the camp!
Reclaiming the House#009.dst: 做好准备，士兵！保护营地！
Reclaiming the House#009.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#010.src: Kill the mobs raiding the Camp.

Reclaiming the House#011.src: This is the third attack in three days! How many reinforcements have they got?!
Reclaiming the House#011.dst: 这是三天里的第三次袭击了！他们到底有多少援军？！
Reclaiming the House#011.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#012.src: Gah! Their casters are strong, careful!
Reclaiming the House#012.dst: 啊！他们的施法者很强，小心！
Reclaiming the House#012.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#013.src: Talk to Elphaba for information on the upcoming attack.
Reclaiming the House#013.dst: 与 Elphaba 对话，了解即将到来的进攻。

Reclaiming the House#014.src: Ugh, I think that was all of them... Come here now, I'll start up where we left off.
Reclaiming the House#014.dst: 呃，我想那是最后一批了……过来吧，我接着刚才说。
Reclaiming the House#014.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#015.src: Not sure I could have done that myself. I'm lucky you came around when you did, soldier.
Reclaiming the House#015.dst: 我不确定我一个人能不能撑过去。幸好你来得正是时候，士兵。
Reclaiming the House#015.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#016.src: Anyway, it's clear I'm going to need more firepower if I'm going to have a shot at reclaiming that outpost.
Reclaiming the House#016.dst: 总之，很明显，如果我想有机会夺回那个前哨站，就需要更多火力。
Reclaiming the House#016.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#017.src: You've certainly got the fighting chops, so I'd appreciate the aid, but we've got to come up with a plan, fast.
Reclaiming the House#017.dst: 你的战斗本领肯定没问题，所以我很感激你的帮忙，但我们得赶快想个计划。
Reclaiming the House#017.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#018.src: There's an old tower near the outpost- some old storage silo. It was built taller than the fort, so we might be able to spy on them from there.
Reclaiming the House#018.dst: 前哨站附近有一座旧塔——是个旧仓储筒仓。它盖得比要塞还高，所以我们也许能从那里侦察他们。
Reclaiming the House#018.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#019.src: It's a risk though, since it's so close by, but we have no other options. Meet me at the tower southeast of here so we can survey the situation.
Reclaiming the House#019.dst: 不过那里离得很近，有风险，但我们别无选择。在这里东南边的塔跟我会合，我们去看看情况。
Reclaiming the House#019.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#020.src: Go to the watch tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to plan the attack.

Reclaiming the House#021.src: Soldier! I'm right behind you. You can see our outpost- and the tower I mentioned.
Reclaiming the House#021.dst: 士兵！我就在你后面。你看得到我们的前哨站——还有我说的那座塔。
Reclaiming the House#021.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#022.src: We need to find a way in. A lot of soldiers were caught unaware during the Orcs' assault, too.
Reclaiming the House#022.dst: 我们得想办法进去。兽人突袭的时候，也有很多士兵措手不及。
Reclaiming the House#022.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#023.src: If there's any survivors in there, we should make rescuing them a priority.
Reclaiming the House#023.dst: 如果里面还有幸存者，我们应该优先救他们。
Reclaiming the House#023.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#024.src: After all, it means more manpower for us. We can't count on that being the case, though...
Reclaiming the House#024.dst: 毕竟那代表我们有更多人手。不过我们不能指望真有幸存者……
Reclaiming the House#024.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#025.src: Come on, hurry inside before one of the orcs spots us!
Reclaiming the House#025.dst: 快，趁兽人发现我们之前赶紧进去！
Reclaiming the House#025.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#026.src: Enter to the watch tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to plan the attack.

Reclaiming the House#027.src: Alright, this is a pretty clear view. Let's see what's going on in there...
Reclaiming the House#027.dst: 好，这里视野很清楚。我们来看看里面发生了什么……
Reclaiming the House#027.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#028.src: Wh- I'm shocked! In the middle there- they just caged the soldiers instead of killing them? That's... kind of a relief.
Reclaiming the House#028.dst: 什——我太惊讶了！在正中间——他们没杀那些士兵，只是把他们关进笼子里？这……算是松了一口气。
Reclaiming the House#028.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#029.src: There's definitely too many orcs in the plaza for us to take down on our own...
Reclaiming the House#029.dst: 广场上的兽人肯定太多了，我们俩打不过……
Reclaiming the House#029.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#030.src: ...but that cage is held up by those ropes. If we can cut them, the other soldiers should be able to help!
Reclaiming the House#030.dst: ……不过那个笼子是用那些绳子吊着的。如果我们能割断绳子，其他士兵应该就能帮忙！
Reclaiming the House#030.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#031.src: Alright, now I just need to figure out how we can both get in... There's sentries on the perimeter, so going over may no be an option...
Reclaiming the House#031.dst: 好，现在我只需要想想我们俩要怎么进去……外围有哨兵，所以翻墙可能行不通……
Reclaiming the House#031.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#032.src: Maybe we can keep an eye out on their sentry patterns and look for an opening-
Reclaiming the House#032.dst: 也许我们可以观察他们哨兵的巡逻规律，找个空档——
Reclaiming the House#032.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#033.src: Humans on old tower! Junhur will shoot! This our place now, get out!!
Reclaiming the House#033.dst: 人类在旧塔上！Junhur 要开炮！这里现在是我们的，滚出去！！
Reclaiming the House#033.speaker: Orc

Reclaiming the House#034.src: Aw, not now! I knew this was a risk, no time to get out... Brace for impact!!
Reclaiming the House#034.dst: 啊，偏偏这个时候！我就知道有风险，来不及出去了……准备迎接冲击！！
Reclaiming the House#034.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#035.src: Old tower fall! Junhur is best cannon shooter!!
Reclaiming the House#035.dst: 旧塔倒了！Junhur 是最强炮手！！
Reclaiming the House#035.speaker: Orc

Reclaiming the House#036.src: Agh, soldier!! Are you alright, where'd you fall?!
Reclaiming the House#036.dst: 啊，士兵！！你没事吧，你掉到哪去了？！
Reclaiming the House#036.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#037.src: Ah... Wow. You barely look scratched, you must've gotten really lucky.
Reclaiming the House#037.dst: 啊……哇。你几乎没受什么伤，运气一定好得不得了。
Reclaiming the House#037.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#038.src: Not so much here... I'm pretty battered after that. At least one of us is in good condition...
Reclaiming the House#038.dst: 我这边就没那么好了……摔完我伤得不轻。至少我们俩有一个状况还好……
Reclaiming the House#038.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#039.src: Unfortunately, that means figuring a way in is up to you. We can't examine their sentry patterns from down here.
Reclaiming the House#039.dst: 可惜，这代表得由你来想办法进去了。在下面这里没法观察他们哨兵的巡逻规律。
Reclaiming the House#039.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#040.src: I'll survive, sure, but I won't be able to walk around and defend myself for a while.
Reclaiming the House#040.dst: 我死不了，但有一阵子没办法走动，也保护不了自己。
Reclaiming the House#040.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#041.src: I hate leaving you on your own like this, but if it's any consolation, you should be tough enough, or lucky enough, to get through.
Reclaiming the House#041.dst: 我很不想让你一个人去，但如果能让你安心点，你应该够强，或者说够幸运，能闯过去。
Reclaiming the House#041.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#042.src: Explore the perimeter of the outpost. Try to find a way in, but be careful, okay?
Reclaiming the House#042.dst: 去前哨站外围探索一下。想办法进去，不过要小心，好吗？
Reclaiming the House#042.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#043.src: Explore the outpost's surroundings to find another way in.
Reclaiming the House#043.dst: 探索前哨站周围，寻找其他入口。

Reclaiming the House#044.src: Follow the trail of mud left by the orc. It leads to the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Reclaiming the House#044.dst: 跟着兽人留下的泥巴痕迹走。它通往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的洞窟

Reclaiming the House#045.src: Enter the outpost while covered in mud.
Reclaiming the House#045.dst: 浑身沾满泥巴进入前哨站。

Reclaiming the House#046.dst: 又是满身泥的兽人？进去，快！
Reclaiming the House#046.speaker: Orc Guard

Reclaiming the House#047.src: Cut the ropes to free the guards from the cage.
Reclaiming the House#047.dst: 割断绳子，把守卫从笼子里放出来。

Reclaiming the House#049.src: Good thinking with the mud disguise, soldier! They never suspected a thing, now come help us out over here!
Reclaiming the House#049.dst: 泥巴伪装真聪明，士兵！他们一点都没起疑，快过来帮我们！
Reclaiming the House#049.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#050.src: Kill the Orcish Overtakers, we'll help keep the other ones off you!
Reclaiming the House#050.dst: 击杀兽人夺取者，其他的我们帮你挡住！
Reclaiming the House#050.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#051.src: Open the gate with a spell

Reclaiming the House#052.src: The Overtakers are down, the other Orcs are flailing! Open the outpost's entrance with a spell now, we've got this under control!
Reclaiming the House#052.dst: 夺取者倒下了，其他兽人乱成一团！现在用法术打开前哨站的入口，这里我们控制得住！
Reclaiming the House#052.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#054.src: Phew... That's some fine work there, soldier! The outpost is back under our control!
Reclaiming the House#054.dst: 呼……干得真漂亮，士兵！前哨站又回到我们手里了！
Reclaiming the House#054.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#055.src: Glad to see some more capable Wynnic hands over here. Though, I didn't catch your name. Would you mind?
Reclaiming the House#055.dst: 很高兴看到这边又多了些能干的 Wynn 人手。不过，我还没问你的名字。能告诉我吗？
Reclaiming the House#055.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#056.src: , huh? I'll remember that. You barely even needed my help, heh... Wish I hadn't been such a burden, but at least it worked out.
Reclaiming the House#056.dst: ，是吧？我会记住的。你几乎不需要我帮忙，呵……真希望我没拖后腿，不过至少结果是好的。
Reclaiming the House#056.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#057.src: Here- it's some of my own personal spending money, as a thank-you gift.
Reclaiming the House#057.dst: 给——这是我自己的一点零花钱，当作谢礼。
Reclaiming the House#057.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#058.src: Alright everyone, let's get this place ship-shape! Everything needs to be repaired in case of another attack!!
Reclaiming the House#058.dst: 好了，各位，把这里收拾得整整齐齐！所有东西都得修好，以防再有袭击！！
Reclaiming the House#058.speaker: Elphaba
